scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@sol-dorado/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=@sol-dorado/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@sol-dorado/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@sol-dorado/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@sol-dorado/api && npm run build --workspace=@sol-dorado/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@sol-dorado/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@sol-dorado/api && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@sol-dorado/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
